meta.name: Sisters Feud
meta.description:
A woman's refusal to join her sister's twisted scheme sparks betrayal and revenge as she tries to reunite with her long-lost daughter in prison.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 13 Nov 2024 · Mexico, United States of America · Language: Spanish
Studio: MaLuLe Entertainment, Mar Abierto Productions · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 20/20

On your server — Audio: Hindi, English (from file names)

videos.title: Mother and Daughter
videos.overview: An accident changes the course of Perla's and Antonia's lives. Broken in the aftermath, Perla is given a new purpose and is hellbent on revenge.

videos.title: Stolen Lives
videos.overview: In prison, Perla attempts to connect with Jacinta but faces a dangerous duo. Efraín's plan is put in motion. Antonia is shocked by Pedro's request.

videos.title: Wolf at the Door
videos.overview: Struggling with Pedro's decision, Sofía makes a drastic choice. Now free, Perla's desire to reconnect with Jacinta is thwarted by Jacinta's bloodlust.

videos.title: Collapse
videos.overview: After the explosion, Bernardo is injured. Perla and Efraín use the accident to their advantage. Jacinta adopts a new identity, as Antonia gets a shock.

videos.title: I'm Not the Same As Before
videos.overview: Perla confronts Antonia over her past deeds. Bernardo discovers money is being embezzled from the mine. Sofía and Pedro prepare for their wedding.

videos.title: Forgive Me, Perla
videos.overview: Perla and Ana interrupt Sofía and Pedro's wedding. Efraín's enemies target Perla. Antonia's desperation to find Teresa increases.

videos.title: The First Day of the Rest of Your Life
videos.overview: An argument between Antonia and Perla leaves a life hanging in the balance. Máximo bribes Ana. Jacinta juggles her feelings between Lucas and Pedro.

videos.title: Our War
videos.overview: A disturbing discovery in the mines alerts Pedro to his parentage. Lucas makes a vow. Perla tries to find Efraín. Antonia is haunted by the past.

videos.title: From Bad to Worse
videos.overview: An alarming video reveals Antonia's darkest secrets. A confession shocks Bernardo. Lucas makes his move against Pedro.

videos.title: Sterile Environment
videos.overview: Antonia's attack takes a life. Máximo and Antonia strike a deal. Lucas' obsession ensnares innocents. Bernardo's last message drops a bombshell.

videos.title: A Price on Her Head
videos.overview: As Antonia goes on the run, Perla works to hunt her down. Orlando falls into a trap. Bernardo's will forces Jacinta to come clean to Pedro.

videos.title: The Little Time I Have Left
videos.overview: Efraín's arrest takes him away from Perla — and leaves room for Máximo. Lucas and Jacinta share an intimate moment. An accident isolates Antonia.

videos.title: No One Left for You
videos.overview: Antonia overhears a shocking development concerning Jacinta and Pedro. Jacinta goes missing. Sofía and Ana make a discovery.

videos.title: This Is How Things Went
videos.overview: Perla suspects Máximo of lying to her, as her secret shocks Efraín and Pedro. Sofía and Ana investigate their kidnapping. Julia asks Perla for help.

videos.title: There Is No Debt That Cannot Be Repaid
videos.overview: Efraín's jealousy gets the best of him. Perla answers for her schemes, as Máximo crosses a line. Sofía discovers a devastating truth about her father.

videos.title: Open Sesame
videos.overview: Máximo's house of cards starts to crack. Perla cracks a code, as Antonia launches her war. Jacinta's meeting with Bernardo turns out to be the last.

videos.title: I'm the New Boss
videos.overview: Perla takes charge of the plan to find her sister, as Antonia gets revenge – and assumes a new role. Jacinta and Pedro prepare for their baby's arrival.

videos.title: The Beginning of the End
videos.overview: As Pedro's health deteriorates, a moment of happiness for him and Jacinta is cut short. Efraín stumbles upon Consuelo's secret. Antonia's threats mount.

videos.title: The Belly of the Dragon
videos.overview: Pedro receives a surprise visitor. Perla and Efraín find valuable information. Sofía and Ana take an important step in their relationship.

videos.title: End Point
videos.overview: As they excavate their pasts, Perla and Antonia confront each other in one final meeting. Pedro and Jacinta's lives change forever as tensions rise.
